responsibility: Implements tree-SSA analysis and estimation of loop iteration counts. It derives symbolic and bounded trip counts from affine exits, guards, scalar-evolution expressions, value ranges, and overflow reasoning; records exact and estimated iteration metadata on loop structures; answers max/likely/estimated execution-count queries for loops and statements; and provides helpers to simplify loop conditions and to invalidate or substitute cached iteration information when transformations modify the loop.
same_name_distinction: Implements loop trip-count and execution-count analysis, including deriving iteration bounds, overflow reasoning, cached estimate maintenance, and substitution into stored loop info. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-loop-niter.h, this file contains the actual analysis and cache-management code.
